en.html:
The opponent was an amateur. However I considered it, that was what I had before me.

Heat was a warrior's lifeline. On that essential point, the enemy had simply not applied itself.
full throttle, from beginning to end.

A picture-perfect headlong charge. Certainly, I was not entitled to take its violence lightly.
Once I had become accustomed to it, however, what was left? One monotonous rush, easy to read, easy to handle.

Having recovered, I had no intention of joining in this headlong foolishness. Let the momentum pass; endure until the assault was spent. To this method I kept strictly.
The result probably did not take very long to appear.

Four times the heat? Very good. But where was the provision for not wasting it?
Spend without discretion, and even that would quickly run out.
Generations for accumulating the fortune; for using it all up, one spendthrift was quite sufficient. The principle was the same.



And now the enemy was on the verge of bankruptcy.

The contest was decided.

ja.html:
対敵はやはり、どうにも素人であった。

　武者の生命線である熱量の運用について、余りにも
配慮がない。
　終始、<ruby>全開<rt>フルスロットル</rt></ruby>。

　絵に描いたような猪突猛進ぶりは、無論、油断すべ
からざる暴威ではある。
　が、こちらがそれに慣れてしまえば、ただの見切り
易く<ruby>捌<rt>さば</rt></ruby>き易い単調な突撃でしかなかった。

　態勢を立て直した<ruby>村正<rt>おれ</rt></ruby>は、敵騎の猛進に付き合う愚
を戒め、勢いを受け流し、凌ぎ切る戦いに徹した。
　その戦術の効果が顕れるまで、大して長い時間では
なかったろう。

　四倍の熱量とて、無分別に放出すれば<ruby>忽<rt>たちま</rt></ruby>ち尽く。
　累代の財産がたった一人の浪費家に使い潰されるの
と同じ事だ。


　そうして、敵騎の<ruby>破産<rt>・・</rt></ruby>は今や目前。

　勝負はついていた。
